title: Understanding rates of change
competency: Find rates of change: from two points, average over an interval, and instantaneous.

keywords.def: Change in output ÷ change in input, in output units per input unit.
(f(b) − f(a))/(b − a): the change of f per unit over the interval [a, b].
The value (f(x₀ + h) − f(x₀))/h approaches as h gets closer to 0.

en.text: A rate of change tells how much one quantity changes for each unit of another: change in output ÷ change in input. From two points it is (y₂ − y₁)/(x₂ − x₁). It can be positive (rising), negative (falling), zero (flat) or undefined (a vertical line).

am.text: የለውጥ መጠን አንዱ መጠን ለሌላው እያንዳንዱ ምድብ ምን ያህል እንደሚለወጥ ይነግራል፤ (y₂ − y₁)/(x₂ − x₁)።

screens.title: A growing square
screens.ask: A square has side 4 cm. The side grows by 1 cm. How much does the perimeter grow?
screens.after:
P = 4s, so the perimeter is 4 times the side.
Side 4 cm: P = 16 cm. Side 5 cm: P = 20 cm.
The perimeter grows by 4 cm for each 1 cm of side.

screens.title: Rate of change
paras: A rate of change describes how one quantity changes in relation to another.
Its units are output units per input unit.
Examples: cost per minute, kilometres per litre, salary per month.

screens.title: Rise over run

points.name: B
points.info: From A: run 1 right (Δx = 1), rise 3 up (Δy = 3). Rate = 3/1 = 3.

screens.ask: Tap A, then B. How far right? How far up?

screens.title: Four kinds
paras: Rates of change can be positive, negative, zero or undefined.

screens.title: Four kinds of rate
screens.ask: Tap each kind to see its graph and an example.
items: The line rises left to right. (1, 2) to (3, 4): Δy/Δx = 2/2 = 1.
The line falls left to right. (2, 3) to (3, 1): Δy/Δx = −2/1 = −2.
The line is horizontal. (0, 2) to (2, 2): Δy/Δx = 0/2 = 0.
The line is vertical. (2, 0) to (2, 2): Δy/Δx = 2/0, no value.

screens.title: Key words
defs: Change in output ÷ change in input, in output units per input unit.

screens.text: Find the rate of change between (4, 6) and (5, 9):
screens.why:
Rate of change = Δy/Δx.
Δy = 9 − 6 = 3.
Δx = 5 − 4 = 1.
Rate = 3/1 = 3.
Trap: 1/3 puts Δx on top.
screens.clue: Change in y on top, change in x below.

screens.title: Positive, negative, zero or undefined?
screens.why:
Work out Δy and Δx for each pair first.
Δy = 0 (Δx not 0): the rate is 0, a horizontal line.
Δx = 0: you cannot divide by 0, so it is undefined (vertical line).
Otherwise the sign of Δy/Δx gives positive or negative.
Example: (1, 2), (3, −4) gives −6/2 = −3, negative.
screens.clue: Work out the top and the bottom first.

screens.ask: Find the rate of change between (−2, 4) and (3, −6): ___
screens.why:
Δy = −6 − 4 = −10.
Δx = 3 − (−2) = 3 + 2 = 5.
Rate = −10/5 = −2.
Trap: 3 − 2 = 1 forgets the double negative.

screens.text: True or false: the line through (2, 0) and (2, 2) has rate of change 0.
screens.why:
Δy = 2 − 0 = 2.
Δx = 2 − 2 = 0.
2/0 has no value, so the rate is undefined.
Both x-values are 2: the line is vertical.
Rate 0 belongs to a horizontal line (Δy = 0). So: false.
screens.clue: What is the change in x?

screens.ask: Rate of change in a word problem: a taxi fare is 30 birr for 2 km and 54 birr for 6 km (a straight-line rule). The rate of change is ___ birr per km
screens.why:
Input: distance. Output: fare.
Δ fare = 54 − 30 = 24 birr.
Δ distance = 6 − 2 = 4 km.
Rate = 24 ÷ 4 = 6 birr per km.
Check: 30 + 4 × 6 = 54. ✓
screens.clue: Change in fare ÷ change in distance.

en.text: The average rate of change of f on [a, b] is (f(b) − f(a))/(b − a). For distance and time it is the average velocity. A straight line has the same average rate everywhere; a curve does not.

am.text: የ f አማካይ የለውጥ መጠን በ [a, b] ላይ (f(b) − f(a))/(b − a) ነው።

screens.title: A car on the road
screens.ask: A car has gone 10 m at t = 2 s and 43 m at t = 4 s. What is its average speed?
screens.after:
Average speed = change in distance ÷ change in time.
(43 − 10)/(4 − 2) = 33/2 = 16.5 m/s.
33 m/s forgets to divide by the 2 seconds.

screens.title: Average rate of f(x) = x²
screens.note: For x² the average rate on [a, b] is a + b. It changes with the interval.

screens.title: Average velocity of the car
screens.ask: Tap an interval of the car table. Each gives a different average.

screens.title: Key words
defs: (f(b) − f(a))/(b − a): the change of f per unit over the interval [a, b].

screens.ask: Find the average rate of change of f(x) = 2x − 9 from x = 3 to x = 6: ___
screens.why:
f(6) = 2(6) − 9 = 3.
f(3) = 2(3) − 9 = −3.
Average rate = (3 − (−3))/(6 − 3) = 6/3 = 2.
Check: f is a line with slope 2, so every interval gives 2.

screens.ask: Use the car table (S in metres, t in seconds). Average velocity for 2 ≤ t ≤ 3 = ___ m/s
screens.why:
Read the table: S(2) = 10 m and S(3) = 25 m.
ΔS = 25 − 10 = 15 m.
Δt = 3 − 2 = 1 s.
Average velocity = 15/1 = 15 m/s.
screens.clue: Read S at t = 2 and t = 3.

screens.text: Find the average rate of change of f(x) = x² + 3x + 1 on [0, k] (k ≠ 0):
screens.why:
f(k) = k² + 3k + 1 and f(0) = 1.
f(k) − f(0) = k² + 3k.
Divide by k − 0 = k: (k² + 3k)/k = k + 3.
Trap: k² + 3k forgets to divide by k.
Trap: 2k + 3 is the rate at one point, not the average.

screens.ask: Average rate of change of a price: petrol cost 2.84 Birr in 2007 and 2.41 Birr in 2009. Rate = ___ Birr per year
screens.why:
Δ cost = 2.41 − 2.84 = −0.43 Birr.
Δ time = 2009 − 2007 = 2 years.
Rate = −0.43 ÷ 2 = −0.215 Birr per year.
The minus sign means the price fell.
screens.clue: It is negative: the price fell.

screens.ask: Use a steady rate: a candle is 10 cm long. After 30 minutes it is 7 cm. It burns out after ___ minutes
screens.why:
Rate = (7 − 10)/30 = −3/30 = −0.1 cm per minute.
Length after t minutes: L = 10 − 0.1t.
Burnt out when L = 0: 0.1t = 10.
t = 10 ÷ 0.1 = 100 minutes.
Check: after 30 min, 10 − 3 = 7 cm. ✓

en.text: The instantaneous rate of change at x₀ is what (f(x₀ + h) − f(x₀))/h approaches as h gets closer and closer to 0. Method: expand f(x₀ + h), cancel the constant terms, divide by h, then let h go to 0.

am.text: በ x₀ ላይ ያለው ቅጽበታዊ የለውጥ መጠን h ወደ 0 ሲቀርብ (f(x₀ + h) − f(x₀))/h የሚቀርበው ቁጥር ነው።

screens.title: Shrink the interval
screens.ask: For y = x³ the average rate from x = 1 to 1.1 is 3.31, and from 1 to 1.001 it is 3.003001. What does it approach?
screens.after:
The averages 3.31, then 3.003001, get closer and closer to 3.
That value, 3, is the rate at the instant x = 1.
3.3 is only one average, over a wide interval.

screens.title: Shrink h
screens.note: At h = 0.1 it is 3.31. Near h = 0 it is 3.

screens.title: Shrink h from both sides
screens.ask: Tap each h. Watch ((1 + h)³ − 1)/h for y = x³ at x = 1.

screens.title: Instantaneous rate of change
paras: It is the change at one particular moment.
Use (f(x₀ + h) − f(x₀))/h and let h get closer and closer to 0.
screens.note: Average rate: over an interval. Instantaneous rate: at one point.

screens.title: Key words
defs: The value (f(x₀ + h) − f(x₀))/h approaches as h gets closer to 0.

screens.ask: Find the instantaneous rate of change of f(x) = 6x² − 3 at x = 1: ___
screens.clue: Expand (1 + h)², cancel, divide by h.

screens.text: Find the instantaneous rate of change of f(x) = √x at x = x₀ (x₀ > 0):
screens.why:
Start with (√(x₀ + h) − √x₀)/h.
Multiply top and bottom by √(x₀ + h) + √x₀.
The top becomes (x₀ + h) − x₀ = h.
Cancel h: 1/(√(x₀ + h) + √x₀).
As h → 0: 1/(√x₀ + √x₀) = 1/(2√x₀).

screens.ask: Instantaneous rate of growth: biomass f(t) = 81t³ + 90 mg. Growth rate at t = 3 min = ___ mg/min

screens.text: True or false: to find the instantaneous rate, you put h = 0 first.
screens.why:
Put h = 0 first and you get (f(x₀) − f(x₀))/0 = 0/0.
0/0 has no value.
Right order: expand, cancel h, then let h → 0.
So the statement is false.

screens.ask: Find the instantaneous rate of change of f(x) = x² − 4x at x = 5: ___

items.ask: Find the rate of change between (4, 6) and (5, 9): ___
Find the rate of change between (4, 7) and (5, 6): ___
items.why:
Δy = 6 − 7 = −1.
Δx = 5 − 4 = 1.
Rate = −1/1 = −1 (the line goes down).

items.ask: Find the rate of change between (1, 2) and (3, −4): ___
Find the rate of change between (−2, 4) and (3, −6): ___

items.text: Find the rate of change between (8, 0) and (8, 8):
items.why:
Δy = 8 − 0 = 8.
Δx = 8 − 8 = 0.
8/0 has no value: undefined.
The line x = 8 is vertical.
0 would be the rate of a horizontal line.

items.ask: Find the rate of change between (3, −1) and (1, −1): ___
items.why:
Δy = −1 − (−1) = 0.
Δx = 1 − 3 = −2.
Rate = 0/(−2) = 0.
Both y-values are −1: the line is horizontal.

items.ask: Average rate of change of f(x) = 3x − 2 on 0 ≤ x ≤ 2: ___
Average rate of change of f(x) = x³ − 3x on 1 ≤ x ≤ 6: ___
Average rate of change of f(x) = 3x − 2 on [1, 5]: ___
items.why:
f(5) = 15 − 2 = 13.
f(1) = 3 − 2 = 1.
(13 − 1)/(5 − 1) = 12/4 = 3.
A line has the same rate on every interval: its slope 3.

items.text: Average rate of change of f(x) = x² + 3x + 1 on [0, k]:
items.why:
f(k) = k² + 3k + 1 and f(0) = 1.
f(k) − f(0) = k² + 3k.
Divide by k: (k² + 3k)/k = k + 3.
Trap: 3 is the slope of 3x only; it ignores x².

items.ask: Average rate of change of the petrol price from 2007 (2.84 Birr) to 2009 (2.41 Birr): ___ Birr per year
items.why:
Δ cost = 2.41 − 2.84 = −0.43 Birr.
Δ time = 2 years.
Rate = −0.43 ÷ 2 = −0.215 Birr per year.

items.ask: Rate of change of a candle's length: 10 cm → 7 cm in 30 min. Rate = ___ cm/min
items.why:
Δ length = 7 − 10 = −3 cm.
Δ time = 30 min.
Rate = −3/30 = −0.1 cm/min.
Negative: the candle gets shorter.

items.ask: Instantaneous rate of change of f(x) = 6x² − 3 at x = 1: ___

items.text: Instantaneous rate of change of f(x) = 2√x at x = x₀:
items.why:
(2√(x₀ + h) − 2√x₀)/h = 2 × (√(x₀ + h) − √x₀)/h.
For √x the rate is 1/(2√x₀).
Twice that: 2 × 1/(2√x₀) = 1/√x₀.
Trap: 1/(2√x₀) forgets the factor 2.

items.ask: Instantaneous growth rate of biomass f(t) = 81t³ + 90 at t = 3: ___ mg/min

test.ask: Find the rate of change between (1, 5) and (4, 11): ___

test.text: What is the rate of change of a horizontal line?
test.why:
On a horizontal line every y-value is the same.
So Δy = 0 and Δy/Δx = 0/Δx = 0.
Undefined is the rate of a vertical line (Δx = 0).

test.ask: Average rate of change of f(x) = x² on [1, 4]: ___
Instantaneous rate of change of f(x) = 3x² + 1 at x = 2: ___
test.why:
f(2 + h) = 3(4 + 4h + h²) + 1 = 13 + 12h + 3h².
f(2) = 13.
Difference: 12h + 3h². Divide by h: 12 + 3h.
As h → 0: 12.

test.ask: Average velocity: S(t) = t³ metres. Average velocity on [1, 3] = ___ m/s
test.why:
S(3) = 27 m and S(1) = 1 m.
ΔS = 26 m, Δt = 2 s.
Average velocity = 26/2 = 13 m/s.
